youtube._note: apiKey here is a FALLBACK. Preferred setup: set YOUTUBE_API_KEY in Vercel env vars so /api/youtube.js proxies the calls and the key never reaches the browser. The site tries the proxy first and only uses this if the proxy isn't configured. Once the proxy works, delete apiKey below and regenerate it in Google Cloud.

discord._setup: 1) discord.com/developers → your app → OAuth2 → Redirects → add EXACTLY https://crixgamingvr.com/flappycrix  2) copy the Client ID below  3) put CLIENT SECRET in Vercel env vars as DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET — never here, this file is public.
_vercelEnvVars: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT = the full service-account JSON on one line

playfab._setup: Get titleId from PlayFab Game Manager -> Title Settings -> API Features. currencyCode must exactly match the 2-character code you create under Economy -> Currency.

voice._setup: Photon Voice needs its own App ID — create one at dashboard.photonengine.com and pick the 'Voice' product (NOT Realtime, that's the separate one already above).
